proves.claim: With submit.proofOnly off, a proof-only item whose clauses are all ticked is refused EMPTY_SUBMIT with text naming submit.proofOnly.

cli.io-submit-proof-only.off-refusal-nam.why: Without it, a builder or coordinator with a proof-only item never learns that submit.proofOnly is the way to submit it.

proves.claim: With submit.proofOnly off, an item with a [test] clause keeps the existing EMPTY_SUBMIT text, which does not name submit.proofOnly.

cli.io-submit-proof-only.test-clause-kee.why: Without it, a builder or coordinator with a proof-only item never learns that submit.proofOnly is the way to submit it.
